extracted.name: Byrdhouse Blistered Cherry Tomatoes
extracted.description: These blistered cherry tomatoes are as tasty as they are pretty on the plate. This recipe is an easy way to make tomatoes for a side or a salad.
instruction_lines: Melt butter in a skillet over medium-high heat. Add cherry tomatoes, basil, and sugar. Cook for about 30 seconds, then season to taste with salt and pepper. Continue cooking for a few seconds more until tomatoes have just started to blister.
